49 class DashScopeChatModel(ChatModelBase):
50     """The DashScope chat model class, which unifies the Generation and
51     MultimodalConversation APIs into one method."""
52 
53     def __init__(
54         self,
55         model_name: str,
56         api_key: str,
57         stream: bool = True,
58         enable_thinking: bool | None = None,
59         generate_kwargs: dict[str, JSONSerializableObject] | None = None,
60         base_http_api_url: str | None = None,
61         **_kwargs: Any,
62     ) -> None:
63         """Initialize the DashScope chat model.
64 
65         Args:
66             model_name (`str`):
67                 The model names.
68             api_key (`str`):
69                 The dashscope API key.
70             stream (`bool`):
71                 The streaming output or not
72             enable_thinking (`bool | None`, optional):
73                 Enable thinking or not, only support Qwen3, QwQ, DeepSeek-R1.
74                 Refer to `DashScope documentation
75                 <https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/deep-thinking>`_
76                 for more details.
77             generate_kwargs (`dict[str, JSONSerializableObject] | None`, \
78             optional):
79                The extra keyword arguments used in DashScope API generation,
80                e.g. `temperature`, `seed`.
81             base_http_api_url (`str | None`, optional):
82                 The base URL for DashScope API requests. If not provided,
83                 the default base URL from the DashScope SDK will be used.
84             **_kwargs (`Any`):
85                 Additional keyword arguments.
86         """
87         if enable_thinking and not stream:
88             logger.info(
89                 "In DashScope API, `stream` must be True when "
90                 "`enable_thinking` is True. ",
91             )
92             stream = True
93 
94         super().__init__(model_name, stream)
95 
96         self.api_key = api_key
97         self.enable_thinking = enable_thinking
98         self.generate_kwargs = generate_kwargs or {}
99 
100         if base_http_api_url is not None:
101             import dashscope
102 
103             dashscope.base_http_api_url = base_http_api_url
104 
105         # Load headers from environment variable if exists
106         headers = os.getenv("DASHSCOPE_API_HEADERS")
107         if headers:
108             try:
109                 headers = json.loads(str(headers))
110                 if not isinstance(headers, dict):
111                     raise json.JSONDecodeError("", "", 0)
112 
113                 if self.generate_kwargs.get("headers"):
114                     headers.update(self.generate_kwargs["headers"])
115 
116                 self.generate_kwargs["headers"] = headers
117 
118             except json.JSONDecodeError:
119                 logger.warning(
120                     "Failed to parse DASHSCOPE_API_HEADERS environment "
121                     "variable as JSON. It should be a JSON object.",
122                 )
123 
124     @trace_llm
125     async def __call__(
126         self,
127         messages: list[dict[str, Any]],
128         tools: list[dict] | None = None,
129         tool_choice: Literal["auto", "none", "required"] | str | None = None,
130         structured_model: Type[BaseModel] | None = None,
131         **kwargs: Any,
132     ) -> ChatResponse | AsyncGenerator[ChatResponse, None]:
133         """Get the response from the dashscope
134         Generation/MultimodalConversation API by the given arguments.
135 
136         .. note:: We unify the dashscope generation and multimodal conversation
137          APIs into one method, since they support similar arguments and share
138          the same functionality.
139 
140         Args:
141             messages (`list[dict[str, Any]]`):
142                 A list of dictionaries, where `role` and `content` fields are
143                 required.
144             tools (`list[dict] | None`, default `None`):
145                 The tools JSON schemas that the model can use.
146             tool_choice (`Literal["auto", "none", "required"] | str \
147              |  None`,  default `None`):
148                 Controls which (if any) tool is called by the model.
149                  Can be "auto", "none", "required", or specific tool name.
150                  Note: DashScope API only supports "auto" and "none", so
151                  "required" will be converted to "auto".
152                  For more details, please refer to
153                  https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/qwen-function-calling
154             structured_model (`Type[BaseModel] | None`, default `None`):
155                 A Pydantic BaseModel class that defines the expected structure
156                 for the model's output. When provided, the model will be forced
157                 to return data that conforms to this schema by automatically
158                 converting the BaseModel to a tool function and setting
159                 `tool_choice` to enforce its usage. This enables structured
160                 output generation.
161 
162                 .. note:: When `structured_model` is specified,
163                     both `tools` and `tool_choice` parameters are ignored,
164                     and the model will only perform structured output
165                     generation without calling any other tools.
166 
167             **kwargs (`Any`):
168                 The keyword arguments for DashScope chat completions API,
169                 e.g. `temperature`, `max_tokens`, `top_p`, etc. Please
170                 refer to `DashScope documentation
171                 <https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dashscope/developer-reference/api-details>`_
172                 for more detailed arguments.
173         """
174         import dashscope
175 
176         kwargs = {
177             "messages": messages,
178             "model": self.model_name,
179             "stream": self.stream,
180             **self.generate_kwargs,
181             **kwargs,
182             "result_format": "message",
183             # In agentscope, the `incremental_output` must be `True` when
184             # `self.stream` is True
185             "incremental_output": self.stream,
186         }
187 
188         if tools:
189             kwargs["tools"] = self._format_tools_json_schemas(tools)
190 
191         if tool_choice:
192             # Handle deprecated "any" option with warning
193             if tool_choice in ["any", "required"]:
194                 warnings.warn(
195                     f"'{tool_choice}' is not supported by DashScope API. "
196                     "It will be converted to 'auto'.",
197                     DeprecationWarning,
198                 )
199                 tool_choice = "auto"
200 
201             self._validate_tool_choice(tool_choice, tools)
202             kwargs["tool_choice"] = self._format_tool_choice(tool_choice)
203 
204         if (
205             self.enable_thinking is not None
206             and "enable_thinking" not in kwargs
207         ):
208             kwargs["enable_thinking"] = self.enable_thinking
209 
210         if structured_model:
211             if tools or tool_choice:
212                 logger.warning(
213                     "structured_model is provided. Both 'tools' and "
214                     "'tool_choice' parameters will be overridden and "
215                     "ignored. The model will only perform structured output "
216                     "generation without calling any other tools.",
217                 )
218             format_tool = _create_tool_from_base_model(structured_model)
219             kwargs["tools"] = self._format_tools_json_schemas(
220                 [format_tool],
221             )
222             kwargs["tool_choice"] = self._format_tool_choice(
223                 format_tool["function"]["name"],
224             )
225 
226         start_datetime = datetime.now()
227         if self.model_name.startswith("qvq") or "-vl" in self.model_name:
228             response = dashscope.MultiModalConversation.call(
229                 api_key=self.api_key,
230                 **kwargs,
231             )
232 
233         else:
234             response = await dashscope.aigc.generation.AioGeneration.call(
235                 api_key=self.api_key,
236                 **kwargs,
237             )
238 
239         if self.stream:
240             return self._parse_dashscope_stream_response(
241                 start_datetime,
242                 response,
243                 structured_model,
244             )
245 
246         parsed_response = await self._parse_dashscope_generation_response(
247             start_datetime,
248             response,
249             structured_model,
250         )
251 
252         return parsed_response
253 
254     # pylint: disable=too-many-branches
255     async def _parse_dashscope_stream_response(
256         self,
257         start_datetime: datetime,
258         response: Union[
259             AsyncGenerator[GenerationResponse, None],
260             Generator[MultiModalConversationResponse, None, None],
261         ],
262         structured_model: Type[BaseModel] | None = None,
263     ) -> AsyncGenerator[ChatResponse, Any]:
264         """Given a DashScope streaming response generator, extract the content
265             blocks and usages from it and yield ChatResponse objects.
266 
267         Args:
268             start_datetime (`datetime`):
269                 The start datetime of the response generation.
270             response (
271                 `Union[AsyncGenerator[GenerationResponse, None], Generator[ \
272                 MultiModalConversationResponse, None, None]]`
273             ):
274                 DashScope streaming response generator (GenerationResponse or
275                 MultiModalConversationResponse) to parse.
276             structured_model (`Type[BaseModel] | None`, default `None`):
277                 A Pydantic BaseModel class that defines the expected structure
278                 for the model's output.
279 
280         Returns:
281             AsyncGenerator[ChatResponse, Any]:
282                 An async generator that yields ChatResponse objects containing
283                 the content blocks and usage information for each chunk in the
284                 streaming response.
285 
286         .. note::
287             If `structured_model` is not `None`, the expected structured output
288             will be stored in the metadata of the `ChatResponse`.
289         """
290         acc_content, acc_thinking_content = "", ""
291         acc_tool_calls = collections.defaultdict(dict)
292         metadata = None
293 
294         async for chunk in giter(response):
295             if chunk.status_code != HTTPStatus.OK:
296                 raise RuntimeError(
297                     f"Failed to get response from _ API: {chunk}",
298                 )
299 
300             message = chunk.output.choices[0].message
301 
302             # Update reasoning content
303             if isinstance(message.get("reasoning_content"), str):
304                 acc_thinking_content += message["reasoning_content"]
305 
306             # Update text content
307             if isinstance(message.content, str):
308                 acc_content += message.content
309             elif isinstance(message.content, list):
310                 for item in message.content:
311                     if isinstance(item, dict) and "text" in item:
312                         acc_content += item["text"]
313 
314             # Update tool calls
315             for tool_call in message.get("tool_calls", []):
316                 index = tool_call.get("index", 0)
317 
318                 if "id" in tool_call and tool_call["id"] != acc_tool_calls[
319                     index
320                 ].get("id"):
321                     acc_tool_calls[index]["id"] = (
322                         acc_tool_calls[index].get("id", "") + tool_call["id"]
323                     )
324 
325                 if "function" in tool_call:
326                     func = tool_call["function"]
327                     if "name" in func:
328                         acc_tool_calls[index]["name"] = (
329                             acc_tool_calls[index].get("name", "")
330                             + func["name"]
331                         )
332 
333                     if "arguments" in func:
334                         acc_tool_calls[index]["arguments"] = (
335                             acc_tool_calls[index].get("arguments", "")
336                             + func["arguments"]
337                         )
338 
339             # to content blocks
340             content_blocks: list[TextBlock | ToolUseBlock | ThinkingBlock] = []
341             if acc_thinking_content:
342                 content_blocks.append(
343                     ThinkingBlock(
344                         type="thinking",
345                         thinking=acc_thinking_content,
346                     ),
347                 )
348 
349             if acc_content:
350                 content_blocks.append(
351                     TextBlock(
352                         type="text",
353                         text=acc_content,
354                     ),
355                 )
356 
357             for tool_call in acc_tool_calls.values():
358                 repaired_input = _json_loads_with_repair(
359                     tool_call.get("arguments", "{}") or "{}",
360                 )
361 
362                 if not isinstance(repaired_input, dict):
363                     repaired_input = {}
364 
365                 content_blocks.append(
366                     ToolUseBlock(
367                         type="tool_use",
368                         id=tool_call.get("id", ""),
369                         name=tool_call.get("name", ""),
370                         input=repaired_input,
371                     ),
372                 )
373 
374                 if structured_model:
375                     metadata = repaired_input
376 
377             usage = None
378             if chunk.usage:
379                 usage = ChatUsage(
380                     input_tokens=chunk.usage.input_tokens,
381                     output_tokens=chunk.usage.output_tokens,
382                     time=(datetime.now() - start_datetime).total_seconds(),
383                     metadata=chunk.usage,
384                 )
385 
386             parsed_chunk = ChatResponse(
387                 content=content_blocks,
388                 usage=usage,
389                 metadata=metadata,
390             )
391             yield parsed_chunk
392 
393     async def _parse_dashscope_generation_response(
394         self,
395         start_datetime: datetime,
396         response: Union[
397             GenerationResponse,
398             MultiModalConversationResponse,
399         ],
400         structured_model: Type[BaseModel] | None = None,
401     ) -> ChatResponse:
402         """Given a DashScope GenerationResponse object, extract the content
403         blocks and usages from it.
404 
405         Args:
406             start_datetime (`datetime`):
407                 The start datetime of the response generation.
408             response (
409                 `Union[GenerationResponse, MultiModalConversationResponse]`
410             ):
411                 Dashscope GenerationResponse | MultiModalConversationResponse
412                 object to parse.
413             structured_model (`Type[BaseModel] | None`, default `None`):
414                 A Pydantic BaseModel class that defines the expected structure
415                 for the model's output.
416 
417         Returns:
418             ChatResponse (`ChatResponse`):
419                 A ChatResponse object containing the content blocks and usage.
420 
421         .. note::
422             If `structured_model` is not `None`, the expected structured output
423             will be stored in the metadata of the `ChatResponse`.
424         """
425         # Collect the content blocks from the response.
426         if response.status_code != 200:
427             raise RuntimeError(response)
428 
429         content_blocks: List[TextBlock | ToolUseBlock] = []
430         metadata: dict | None = None
431 
432         message = response.output.choices[0].message
433         content = message.get("content")
434 
435         if response.output.choices[0].message.get("content") not in [
436             None,
437             "",
438             [],
439         ]:
440             if isinstance(content, list):
441                 for item in content:
442                     if isinstance(item, dict) and "text" in item:
443                         content_blocks.append(
444                             TextBlock(
445                                 type="text",
446                                 text=item["text"],
447                             ),
448                         )
449             else:
450                 content_blocks.append(
451                     TextBlock(
452                         type="text",
453                         text=content,
454                     ),
455                 )
456 
457         if message.get("tool_calls"):
458             for tool_call in message["tool_calls"]:
459                 input_ = _json_loads_with_repair(
460                     tool_call["function"].get(
461                         "arguments",
462                         "{}",
463                     )
464                     or "{}",
465                 )
466                 content_blocks.append(
467                     ToolUseBlock(
468                         type="tool_use",
469                         name=tool_call["function"]["name"],
470                         input=input_,
471                         id=tool_call["id"],
472                     ),
473                 )
474 
475                 if structured_model:
476                     metadata = input_
477 
478         # Usage information
479         usage = None
480         if response.usage:
481             usage = ChatUsage(
482                 input_tokens=response.usage.input_tokens,
483                 output_tokens=response.usage.output_tokens,
484                 time=(datetime.now() - start_datetime).total_seconds(),
485                 metadata=response.usage,
486             )
487 
488         parsed_response = ChatResponse(
489             content=content_blocks,
490             usage=usage,
491             metadata=metadata,
492         )
493 
494         return parsed_response
495 
496     def _format_tools_json_schemas(
497         self,
498         schemas: list[dict[str, Any]],
499     ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
500         """Format the tools JSON schema into required format for DashScope API.
501 
502         Args:
503             schemas (`dict[str, dict[str, Any]]`):
504                 The tools JSON schemas.
505         """
506         # Check schemas format
507         for value in schemas:
508             if (
509                 not isinstance(value, dict)
510                 or "type" not in value
511                 or value["type"] != "function"
512                 or "function" not in value
513             ):
514                 raise ValueError(
515                     f"Each schema must be a dict with 'type' as 'function' "
516                     f"and 'function' key, got {value}",
517                 )
518 
519         return schemas
520 
521     def _format_tool_choice(
522         self,
523         tool_choice: Literal["auto", "none", "required"] | str | None,
524     ) -> str | dict | None:
525         """Format tool_choice parameter for API compatibility.
526 
527         Args:
528             tool_choice (`Literal["auto", "none", "required"] | str \
529             | None`, default  `None`):
530                 Controls which (if any) tool is called by the model. For more
531                 details, please refer to
532                 https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/qwen-function-calling
533 
534         Returns:
535             `dict | None`:
536                 The formatted tool choice configuration dict, or None if
537                     tool_choice is None.
538         """
539         if tool_choice is None:
540             return None
541         if tool_choice in ["auto", "none"]:
542             return tool_choice
543         if tool_choice == "required":
544             return "auto"
545         return {"type": "function", "function": {"name": tool_choice}}
intended_behavior: Modify this method to track streaming completion (e.g., last=True) for tool call argument strings. Buffer and accumulate partial argument strings until the entire content is received. Call _json_loads_with_repair only after receiving complete streaming data, thereby preventing premature parsing and system hangs/crashes on incomplete multiline JSON/YAML. Preserve existing response construction and yielding behavior once full content is confirmed.

202             kwargs["tool_choice"] = self._format_tool_choice(tool_choice)
203 
204         if (
205             self.enable_thinking is not None
206             and "enable_thinking" not in kwargs
207         ):
208             kwargs["enable_thinking"] = self.enable_thinking
209 
210         if structured_model:
211             if tools or tool_choice:
212                 logger.warning(
213                     "structured_model is provided. Both 'tools' and "
214                     "'tool_choice' parameters will be overridden and "
215                     "ignored. The model will only perform structured output "
216                     "generation without calling any other tools.",
217                 )
218             format_tool = _create_tool_from_base_model(structured_model)
219             kwargs["tools"] = self._format_tools_json_schemas(
220                 [format_tool],
221             )
222             kwargs["tool_choice"] = self._format_tool_choice(
223                 format_tool["function"]["name"],
224             )
225 
226         start_datetime = datetime.now()
227         if self.model_name.startswith("qvq") or "-vl" in self.model_name:
228             response = dashscope.MultiModalConversation.call(
229                 api_key=self.api_key,
230                 **kwargs,
231             )
232 
233         else:
234             response = await dashscope.aigc.generation.AioGeneration.call(
235                 api_key=self.api_key,
236                 **kwargs,
237             )
238 
239         if self.stream:
240             return self._parse_dashscope_stream_response(
241                 start_datetime,
242                 response,
243                 structured_model,
244             )
245 
246         parsed_response = await self._parse_dashscope_generation_response(
247             start_datetime,
248             response,
249             structured_model,
250         )
251 
252         return parsed_response

255     async def _parse_dashscope_stream_response(
256         self,
257         start_datetime: datetime,
258         response: Union[
259             AsyncGenerator[GenerationResponse, None],
260             Generator[MultiModalConversationResponse, None, None],
261         ],
262         structured_model: Type[BaseModel] | None = None,
263     ) -> AsyncGenerator[ChatResponse, Any]:
264         """Given a DashScope streaming response generator, extract the content
265             blocks and usages from it and yield ChatResponse objects.
266 
267         Args:
268             start_datetime (`datetime`):
269                 The start datetime of the response generation.
270             response (
271                 `Union[AsyncGenerator[GenerationResponse, None], Generator[ \
272                 MultiModalConversationResponse, None, None]]`
273             ):
274                 DashScope streaming response generator (GenerationResponse or
275                 MultiModalConversationResponse) to parse.
276             structured_model (`Type[BaseModel] | None`, default `None`):
277                 A Pydantic BaseModel class that defines the expected structure
278                 for the model's output.
279 
280         Returns:
281             AsyncGenerator[ChatResponse, Any]:
282                 An async generator that yields ChatResponse objects containing
283                 the content blocks and usage information for each chunk in the
284                 streaming response.
285 
286         .. note::
287             If `structured_model` is not `None`, the expected structured output
288             will be stored in the metadata of the `ChatResponse`.
289         """
290         acc_content, acc_thinking_content = "", ""
291         acc_tool_calls = collections.defaultdict(dict)
292         metadata = None
293 
294         async for chunk in giter(response):
295             if chunk.status_code != HTTPStatus.OK:
296                 raise RuntimeError(
297                     f"Failed to get response from _ API: {chunk}",
298                 )
299 
300             message = chunk.output.choices[0].message
301 
302             # Update reasoning content
303             if isinstance(message.get("reasoning_content"), str):
304                 acc_thinking_content += message["reasoning_content"]
305 
306             # Update text content
307             if isinstance(message.content, str):
308                 acc_content += message.content
309             elif isinstance(message.content, list):
310                 for item in message.content:
311                     if isinstance(item, dict) and "text" in item:
312                         acc_content += item["text"]
313 
314             # Update tool calls
315             for tool_call in message.get("tool_calls", []):
316                 index = tool_call.get("index", 0)
317 
318                 if "id" in tool_call and tool_call["id"] != acc_tool_calls[
319                     index
320                 ].get("id"):
321                     acc_tool_calls[index]["id"] = (
322                         acc_tool_calls[index].get("id", "") + tool_call["id"]
323                     )
324 
325                 if "function" in tool_call:
326                     func = tool_call["function"]
327                     if "name" in func:
328                         acc_tool_calls[index]["name"] = (
329                             acc_tool_calls[index].get("name", "")
330                             + func["name"]
331                         )
332 
333                     if "arguments" in func:
334                         acc_tool_calls[index]["arguments"] = (
335                             acc_tool_calls[index].get("arguments", "")
336                             + func["arguments"]
337                         )
338 
339             # to content blocks
340             content_blocks: list[TextBlock | ToolUseBlock | ThinkingBlock] = []
341             if acc_thinking_content:
342                 content_blocks.append(
343                     ThinkingBlock(
344                         type="thinking",
345                         thinking=acc_thinking_content,
346                     ),
347                 )
348 
349             if acc_content:
350                 content_blocks.append(
351                     TextBlock(
352                         type="text",
353                         text=acc_content,
354                     ),
355                 )
356 
357             for tool_call in acc_tool_calls.values():
358                 repaired_input = _json_loads_with_repair(
359                     tool_call.get("arguments", "{}") or "{}",
360                 )
361 
362                 if not isinstance(repaired_input, dict):
363                     repaired_input = {}
364 
365                 content_blocks.append(
366                     ToolUseBlock(
367                         type="tool_use",
368                         id=tool_call.get("id", ""),
369                         name=tool_call.get("name", ""),
370                         input=repaired_input,
371                     ),
372                 )
373 
374                 if structured_model:
375                     metadata = repaired_input
376 
377             usage = None
378             if chunk.usage:
379                 usage = ChatUsage(
380                     input_tokens=chunk.usage.input_tokens,
381                     output_tokens=chunk.usage.output_tokens,
382                     time=(datetime.now() - start_datetime).total_seconds(),
383                     metadata=chunk.usage,
384                 )
385 
386             parsed_chunk = ChatResponse(
387                 content=content_blocks,
388                 usage=usage,
389                 metadata=metadata,
390             )
391             yield parsed_chunk
392 
393     async def _parse_dashscope_generation_response(
394         self,
395         start_datetime: datetime,
396         response: Union[
397             GenerationResponse,
398             MultiModalConversationResponse,
399         ],
400         structured_model: Type[BaseModel] | None = None,
401     ) -> ChatResponse:
402         """Given a DashScope GenerationResponse object, extract the content
403         blocks and usages from it.
404 
405         Args:
406             start_datetime (`datetime`):
407                 The start datetime of the response generation.
408             response (
409                 `Union[GenerationResponse, MultiModalConversationResponse]`
410             ):
411                 Dashscope GenerationResponse | MultiModalConversationResponse
412                 object to parse.
413             structured_model (`Type[BaseModel] | None`, default `None`):
414                 A Pydantic BaseModel class that defines the expected structure
415                 for the model's output.
416 
417         Returns:
418             ChatResponse (`ChatResponse`):
419                 A ChatResponse object containing the content blocks and usage.
420 
421         .. note::
422             If `structured_model` is not `None`, the expected structured output
423             will be stored in the metadata of the `ChatResponse`.
424         """
425         # Collect the content blocks from the response.
426         if response.status_code != 200:
427             raise RuntimeError(response)
428 
429         content_blocks: List[TextBlock | ToolUseBlock] = []
430         metadata: dict | None = None
431 
432         message = response.output.choices[0].message
433         content = message.get("content")
434 
435         if response.output.choices[0].message.get("content") not in [
436             None,
437             "",
438             [],
439         ]:
440             if isinstance(content, list):
441                 for item in content:
442                     if isinstance(item, dict) and "text" in item:
443                         content_blocks.append(
444                             TextBlock(
445                                 type="text",
446                                 text=item["text"],
447                             ),
448                         )
449             else:
450                 content_blocks.append(
451                     TextBlock(
452                         type="text",
453                         text=content,
454                     ),
455                 )
456 
457         if message.get("tool_calls"):
458             for tool_call in message["tool_calls"]:
459                 input_ = _json_loads_with_repair(
460                     tool_call["function"].get(
461                         "arguments",
462                         "{}",
463                     )
464                     or "{}",
465                 )
466                 content_blocks.append(
467                     ToolUseBlock(
468                         type="tool_use",
469                         name=tool_call["function"]["name"],
470                         input=input_,
471                         id=tool_call["id"],
472                     ),
473                 )
474 
475                 if structured_model:
476                     metadata = input_
477 
478         # Usage information
479         usage = None
480         if response.usage:
481             usage = ChatUsage(
482                 input_tokens=response.usage.input_tokens,
483                 output_tokens=response.usage.output_tokens,
484                 time=(datetime.now() - start_datetime).total_seconds(),
485                 metadata=response.usage,
486             )
487 
488         parsed_response = ChatResponse(
489             content=content_blocks,
490             usage=usage,
491             metadata=metadata,
492         )
493 
494         return parsed_response
495 
496     def _format_tools_json_schemas(
497         self,
498         schemas: list[dict[str, Any]],
499     ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
500         """Format the tools JSON schema into required format for DashScope API.
501 
502         Args:
503             schemas (`dict[str, dict[str, Any]]`):
504                 The tools JSON schemas.
505         """
506         # Check schemas format
507         for value in schemas:
508             if (
509                 not isinstance(value, dict)
510                 or "type" not in value
511                 or value["type"] != "function"
512                 or "function" not in value
513             ):
514                 raise ValueError(
515                     f"Each schema must be a dict with 'type' as 'function' "
516                     f"and 'function' key, got {value}",
517                 )
518 
519         return schemas
520 
521     def _format_tool_choice(
522         self,
523         tool_choice: Literal["auto", "none", "required"] | str | None,
524     ) -> str | dict | None:
525         """Format tool_choice parameter for API compatibility.
526 
527         Args:
528             tool_choice (`Literal["auto", "none", "required"] | str \
529             | None`, default  `None`):
530                 Controls which (if any) tool is called by the model. For more
531                 details, please refer to
532                 https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/qwen-function-calling
533 
534         Returns:
535             `dict | None`:
536                 The formatted tool choice configuration dict, or None if
537                     tool_choice is None.
538         """
539         if tool_choice is None:
540             return None
541         if tool_choice in ["auto", "none"]:
542             return tool_choice
543         if tool_choice == "required":
544             return "auto"
545         return {"type": "function", "function": {"name": tool_choice}}
